items.title: The Third-Party Agent Problem: Why Security Built for AI You Chose Misses the Agents You Didn't
items.description: In environments studied for the 2026 State of Agent Security Report, roughly 1,280 third-party products now embed AI. About 282 of them sit behind single sign-on.
